result.summary: This is a typical residential street with row housing and on-street parking. While sidewalks are provided, the pedestrian crossing infrastructure is minimal, featuring only a single faded crosswalk marking without accompanying signage or signals.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking near the crossing area limits the visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right curb line adjacent to the faded crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk marking is significantly worn, reducing its effectiveness in alerting drivers to a pedestrian crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental or ladder style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions (daylighting) near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for pedestrians despite the presence of sidewalks. The presence of a school crossing sign suggests high pedestrian demand that is not met by the current infrastructure.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks exist at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without a designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner of the intersection block the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb of the side street

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The curbs at the intersection corners appear to be full height without sloped transitions for accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the sidewalks at the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the intersection to clear sightlines.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

result.summary: The street features a continuous sidewalk but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. Parked vehicles and large trees create significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to enter the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and dense vegetation block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: No designated or marked crossing points are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross an uncontrolled roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to intersections or crossing points to improve sightlines.

result.summary: This is a typical residential street with row houses and continuous sidewalks on at least one side. While the low-speed residential nature is safer than a thoroughfare, the lack of marked crossings and significant visual obstructions from parked cars on both sides of the street increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking on both sides of the narrow roadway creates significant sightline obstructions between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs in this residential block, leaving pedestrians to cross mid-block without designated protection.
